title: list.unzip
description: `list.unzip` splits an input list across N separate outlets by deinterleaving its elements; for example, with N = 2, `1 2 3 4` becomes `1 3` and `2 4`. The integer argument sets the number of output outlets (minimum 1), and `@min` disables padding so an uneven list such as `1 2 3 4 5` produces `1 3 5` and `2 4`.
